description: This file contains unit tests for stream subscription behavior with stateless worker grains in an Orleans-based distributed system. It includes test classes, a test runner, and configuration setup for testing stream producer and consumer interactions, specifically verifying that stateless workers cannot subscribe to streams.

classes.name: StatelessWorkersStreamTests
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying stream subscription restrictions with stateless worker grains in Orleans.

classes.name: StatelessWorkersStreamTestsRunner
classes.description: Helper class to run stream producer and consumer tests, encapsulating the logic for producing messages and setting up consumers.

methods.name: SubscribeToStream_FromStatelessWorker_Fail
methods.description: Test method that verifies subscribing a stateless worker to a stream throws an InvalidOperationException.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Sets up a grain as a stream consumer for a given stream ID.

methods.name: ProduceMessage
methods.description: Produces a message to a specified stream ID using a grain producer.
